      /* ======================================================================
         1. initReducedMotion()
         ====================================================================== */
      function initReducedMotion() {
        const mq = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
        mq.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
          APP_STATE.reducedMotion = e.matches;
          if (APP_STATE.hasGSAP && e.matches) {
            window.ScrollTrigger.getAll().forEach(st => st.kill());
          }
        });
      }

      /* ======================================================================
         2. initSmoothScroll()
         ====================================================================== */
      function initSmoothScroll() {
        const progressBar = document.getElementById('scroll-progress-bar');
        const header = document.getElementById('site-header');

        const updateScrollUI = () => {
          const scrollTop = window.scrollY || document.documentElement.scrollTop;
          const docHeight = document.documentElement.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight;
          const progress = docHeight > 0 ? Math.min(1, Math.max(0, scrollTop / docHeight)) : 0;
          if (progressBar) {
            progressBar.style.transform = `scaleX(${progress})`;
          }
          if (header) {
            header.classList.toggle('is-scrolled', scrollTop > 24);
          }
        };

        window.addEventListener('scroll', updateScrollUI, { passive: true });
        updateScrollUI();

        // Smooth anchor scrolling with header offset & optional focus target
        document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"], [data-scroll-to]').forEach((trigger) => {
          trigger.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const targetSelector = trigger.getAttribute('data-scroll-to') || trigger.getAttribute('href');
            if (!targetSelector || targetSelector === '#') return;
            const targetEl = document.querySelector(targetSelector);
            if (!targetEl) return;

            e.preventDefault();
            closeMobileDrawer();

            const headerOffset = 72;
            const rect = targetEl.getBoundingClientRect();
            const offsetTop = rect.top + window.scrollY - headerOffset;

            window.scrollTo({
              top: Math.max(0, offsetTop),
              behavior: APP_STATE.reducedMotion ? 'auto' : 'smooth'
            });

            const focusSelector = trigger.getAttribute('data-focus-target');
            if (focusSelector) {
              const focusEl = document.querySelector(focusSelector);
              if (focusEl) {
                setTimeout(() => {
                  focusEl.focus({ preventScroll: true });
                }, APP_STATE.reducedMotion ? 50 : 650);
              }
            }
          });
        });
      }

      /* ======================================================================
         3. initNavigation()
         ====================================================================== */
      const mobileToggle = document.getElementById('mobile-menu-toggle');
      const mobileDrawer = document.getElementById('mobile-drawer');

      function closeMobileDrawer() {
        if (!mobileToggle || !mobileDrawer) return;
        mobileToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
        mobileDrawer.classList.remove('is-open');
        mobileDrawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');
      }

      function initNavigation() {
        if (mobileToggle && mobileDrawer) {
          mobileToggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const expanded = mobileToggle.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true';
            if (expanded) {
              closeMobileDrawer();
            } else {
              mobileToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
              mobileDrawer.classList.add('is-open');
              mobileDrawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'false');
            }
          });

          document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Escape' && mobileDrawer.classList.contains('is-open')) {
              closeMobileDrawer();
              mobileToggle.focus();
            }
          });

          document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (
              mobileDrawer.classList.contains('is-open') &&
              !mobileDrawer.contains(e.target) &&
              !mobileToggle.contains(e.target)
            ) {
              closeMobileDrawer();
            }
          });
        }

        // Active section observer for desktop nav links
        const navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link[data-nav-target]');
        const sections = ['memories', 'journey', 'journal', 'download']
          .map(id => document.getElementById(id))
          .filter(Boolean);

        if ('IntersectionObserver' in window && sections.length) {
          const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
            entries.forEach((entry) => {
              if (entry.isIntersecting) {
                const id = entry.target.id;
                navLinks.forEach((link) => {
                  link.classList.toggle('is-active', link.getAttribute('data-nav-target') === id);
                });
              }
            });
          }, { rootMargin: '-35% 0px -55% 0px' });

          sections.forEach(sec => io.observe(sec));
        }

        // One-shot localized wave pulse & magnetic pull on buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('.btn').forEach((btn) => {
          btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (APP_STATE.reducedMotion) return;
            const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
            const ring = document.createElement('span');
            ring.className = 'click-pulse-ring';
            ring.style.width = '36px';
            ring.style.height = '36px';
            ring.style.left = `${e.clientX - rect.left}px`;
            ring.style.top = `${e.clientY - rect.top}px`;
            btn.appendChild(ring);
            setTimeout(() => ring.remove(), 600);
          });
        });

        if (APP_STATE.finePointer && !APP_STATE.reducedMotion) {
          document.querySelectorAll('.magnetic-btn').forEach((btn) => {
            btn.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
              const rect = btn.getBoundingClientRect();
              const dx = (e.clientX - (rect.left + rect.width / 2)) * 0.18;
              const dy = (e.clientY - (rect.top + rect.height / 2)) * 0.22;
              const clampedX = Math.max(-7, Math.min(7, dx));
              const clampedY = Math.max(-6, Math.min(6, dy));
              btn.style.transform = `translate3d(${clampedX}px, ${clampedY}px, 0)`;
            });
            btn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
              btn.style.transform = '';
            });
          });
        }
      }

      /* ======================================================================
         4. initHeroMotion()
         ====================================================================== */
      function initHeroMotion() {
        const heroSection = document.getElementById('hero');
        const ambientWave = document.getElementById('hero-ambient-wave');

        // Subtle 1-2 deg ambient line response on pointer move (baked phone stays intact)
        if (heroSection && ambientWave && APP_STATE.finePointer && !APP_STATE.reducedMotion) {
          heroSection.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            const nx = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth - 0.5) * 2;
            const ny = (e.clientY / window.innerHeight - 0.5) * 2;
            ambientWave.style.transform = `translate3d(${nx * 10}px, ${ny * 6}px, 0)`;
          });
        }

        if (!APP_STATE.hasGSAP || APP_STATE.reducedMotion) return;

        const gsap = window.gsap;
        gsap.registerPlugin(window.ScrollTrigger);

        const tl = gsap.timeline({ defaults: { ease: 'power3.out' } });

        tl.fromTo(
          '.site-header .brand-glyph rect',
          { scaleY: 0.15, opacity: 0 },
          { scaleY: 1, opacity: 1, duration: 0.55, stagger: 0.04 }
        )
        .fromTo(
          '#hero-eyebrow',
          { y: 16, opacity: 0 },
          { y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.6 },
          '-=0.3'
        )
        .fromTo(
          '#hero-title .line-inner',
          { yPercent: 105 },
          { yPercent: 0, duration: 0.9, stagger: 0.11, ease: 'expo.out' },
          '-=0.35'
        )
        .fromTo(
          '#hero-subhead',
          { opacity: 0, y: 14 },
          { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.7 },
          '-=0.5'
        )
        .fromTo(
          '#hero-cta-group .btn',
          { opacity: 0, y: 12 },
          { opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.55, stagger: 0.1 },
          '-=0.45'
        );
      }

      /* ======================================================================
         5. initManifestoWave()
         ====================================================================== */
      function initManifestoWave() {
        if (!APP_STATE.hasGSAP || APP_STATE.reducedMotion) return;
        const gsap = window.gsap;

        const strands = document.querySelectorAll('.manifesto-strand');
        strands.forEach((path) => {
          const length = path.getTotalLength ? path.getTotalLength() : 1600;
          gsap.set(path, {
            strokeDasharray: length,
            strokeDashoffset: length
          });

          gsap.to(path, {
            strokeDashoffset: 0,
            ease: 'none',
            scrollTrigger: {
              trigger: '#memories',
              start: 'top 75%',
              end: 'bottom 35%',
              scrub: 0.6
            }
          });
        });

        document.querySelectorAll('.vignette-phrase').forEach((phrase) => {
          const shiftX = parseFloat(phrase.getAttribute('data-parallax-x') || '0');
          gsap.fromTo(
            phrase,
            { x: -shiftX, opacity: 0.35 },
            {
              x: shiftX,
              opacity: 1,
              ease: 'none',
              scrollTrigger: {
                trigger: phrase,
                start: 'top 88%',
                end: 'bottom 25%',
                scrub: true
              }
            }
          );
        });
      }

      /* ======================================================================
         6. initRecorderDemo()
         ====================================================================== */
      function initRecorderDemo() {
        const instrument = document.getElementById('recorder-instrument');
        const svg = document.getElementById('oscilloscope-svg');
        const triggerBtn = document.getElementById('record-trigger-btn');
        const triggerLabel = document.getElementById('record-btn-label');
        const simBtn = document.getElementById('record-sim-btn');
        const statusText = document.getElementById('recorder-status-text');
        const timerEl = document.getElementById('recorder-timer');
        const privacyMsg = document.getElementById('recorder-privacy-msg');
        const playbackTray = document.getElementById('recorder-playback-tray');
        const audioPlayer = document.getElementById('recorded-audio-player');
        const saveBtn = document.getElementById('save-to-library-btn');
        const deleteBtn = document.getElementById('delete-recording-btn');
        const tiltCard = document.getElementById('record-tilt-card');

        // 3D Tilt on the decorative feature photo frame (pointer:fine only)
        if (tiltCard && APP_STATE.finePointer && !APP_STATE.reducedMotion) {
          tiltCard.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            const rect = tiltCard.getBoundingClientRect();
            const px = (e.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width - 0.5;
            const py = (e.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height - 0.5;
            tiltCard.style.transform = `rotateY(${px * 7}deg) rotateX(${-py * 7}deg)`;
          });
          tiltCard.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => {
            tiltCard.style.transform = '';
          });
        }

        // Pointer radial light tracking inside recorder instrument
        if (instrument && APP_STATE.finePointer) {
          instrument.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            const rect = instrument.getBoundingClientRect();
            instrument.style.setProperty('--pointer-x', `${e.clientX - rect.left}px`);
            instrument.style.setProperty('--pointer-y', `${e.clientY - rect.top}px`);
          });
        }

        // Build 48 oscilloscope vertical bars
        const BAR_COUNT = 48;
        const bars = [];
        if (svg) {
          for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
            const rect = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'rect');
            const x = i * 10 + 2;
            const initialH = 10 + Math.sin(i * 0.45) * 6;
            rect.setAttribute('x', String(x));
            rect.setAttribute('y', String(48 - initialH / 2));
            rect.setAttribute('width', '5');
            rect.setAttribute('height', String(initialH));
            rect.setAttribute('rx', '2.5');
            svg.appendChild(rect);
            bars.push(rect);
          }
        }

        let mediaStream = null;
        let mediaRecorder = null;
        let audioContext = null;
        let analyser = null;
        let audioChunks = [];
        let recordedBlobUrl = null;
        let rafId = null;
        let timerInterval = null;
        let startTime = 0;
        let lastDurationFormatted = '00:08';
        let mode = 'idle'; // 'idle' | 'recording' | 'simulated'

        const formatElapsed = (ms) => {
          const totalSec = ms / 1000;
          const mins = Math.floor(totalSec / 60);
          const secs = Math.floor(totalSec % 60);
          const tenths = Math.floor((ms % 1000) / 100);
          return `${String(mins).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(secs).padStart(2, '0')}.${tenths}`;
        };

        const startTimer = () => {
          startTime = performance.now();
          clearInterval(timerInterval);
          timerInterval = setInterval(() => {
            const elapsed = performance.now() - startTime;
            timerEl.textContent = formatElapsed(elapsed);
            const secs = Math.max(1, Math.round(elapsed / 1000));
            const m = Math.floor(secs / 60);
            const s = secs % 60;
            lastDurationFormatted = `${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
          }, 100);
        };

        const stopTimer = () => {
          clearInterval(timerInterval);
        };

        const resetBars = () => {
          bars.forEach((bar, i) => {
            const h = 10 + Math.sin(i * 0.45) * 6;
            bar.setAttribute('height', String(h));
            bar.setAttribute('y', String(48 - h / 2));
          });
        };

        const stopActiveStreams = () => {
          cancelAnimationFrame(rafId);
          stopTimer();
          if (mediaRecorder && mediaRecorder.state !== 'inactive') {
            try { mediaRecorder.stop(); } catch (_) {}
          }
          if (mediaStream) {
            mediaStream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());
            mediaStream = null;
          }
          if (audioContext && audioContext.state !== 'closed') {
            audioContext.close().catch(() => {});
            audioContext = null;
          }
        };

        const animateLiveMic = () => {
          if (!analyser || mode !== 'recording') return;
          const data = new Uint8Array(analyser.frequencyBinCount);
          analyser.getByteFrequencyData(data);

          for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
            const val = data[i % data.length] || 0;
            const norm = val / 255;
            const h = Math.max(6, Math.min(88, 8 + norm * 80));
            bars[i].setAttribute('height', h.toFixed(1));
            bars[i].setAttribute('y', (48 - h / 2).toFixed(1));
          }
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(animateLiveMic);
        };

        let simPhase = 0;
        const animateSimulation = () => {
          if (mode !== 'simulated') return;
          simPhase += 0.085;
          for (let i = 0; i < BAR_COUNT; i++) {
            const wave1 = Math.sin(simPhase + i * 0.32);
            const wave2 = Math.cos(simPhase * 0.6 - i * 0.18);
            const h = Math.max(8, Math.min(84, 28 + (wave1 * 22) + (wave2 * 18)));
            bars[i].setAttribute('height', h.toFixed(1));
            bars[i].setAttribute('y', (48 - h / 2).toFixed(1));
          }
          rafId = requestAnimationFrame(animateSimulation);
        };

        const activateVisualFallback = (reasonMessage) => {
          stopActiveStreams();
          mode = 'simulated';
          instrument.setAttribute('data-state', 'simulated');
          statusText.textContent = 'VISUAL-ONLY DEMO MODE — NO AUDIO CAPTURED';
          privacyMsg.textContent = reasonMessage || 'Visual-only simulation active — deterministic waveform study (no microphone audio captured).';
          triggerLabel.textContent = 'Record a Moment';
          simBtn.querySelector('span').textContent = 'Stop Visual Simulation';
          startTimer();
          if (!APP_STATE.reducedMotion) {
            animateSimulation();
          }
        };

        const stopVisualFallback = () => {
          stopActiveStreams();
          mode = 'idle';
          instrument.setAttribute('data-state', 'idle');
          statusText.textContent = 'READY · LOCAL SESSION';
          privacyMsg.textContent = 'Visual simulation paused. Click “Record a Moment” for live microphone capture.';
          simBtn.querySelector('span').textContent = 'Run Visual Simulation';
          resetBars();
        };

        // Direct User Click on "Record a Moment"
        triggerBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
          if (mode === 'recording') {
            stopActiveStreams();
            mode = 'idle';
            instrument.setAttribute('data-state', 'idle');
            triggerLabel.textContent = 'Record a Moment';
            statusText.textContent = 'CLIP CAPTURED · LOCAL MEMORY';
            privacyMsg.textContent = 'Recorded locally in this browser — play back below or save to your session archive.';
            resetBars();
            return;
          }

          if (mode === 'simulated') {
            stopVisualFallback();
          }

          if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia || typeof window.MediaRecorder === 'undefined') {
            activateVisualFallback('Browser microphone capture API unavailable in this environment — switched to honest visual-only simulation.');
            return;
          }

          try {
            mediaStream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
            audioChunks = [];
            mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(mediaStream);

            mediaRecorder.addEventListener('dataavailable', (e) => {
              if (e.data && e.data.size > 0) {
                audioChunks.push(e.data);
              }
            });

            mediaRecorder.addEventListener('stop', () => {
              if (audioChunks.length > 0) {
                if (recordedBlobUrl) {
                  URL.revokeObjectURL(recordedBlobUrl);
                }
                const blob = new Blob(audioChunks, { type: mediaRecorder.mimeType || 'audio/webm' });
                recordedBlobUrl = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                audioPlayer.src = recordedBlobUrl;
                playbackTray.classList.add('is-visible');
                saveBtn.disabled = false;
                saveBtn.textContent = '+ Save to Session Library';
              }
            });

            const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
            if (AudioCtx) {
              audioContext = new AudioCtx();
              const source = audioContext.createMediaStreamSource(mediaStream);
              analyser = audioContext.createAnalyser();
              analyser.fftSize = 128;
              source.connect(analyser);
            }

            mediaRecorder.start();
            mode = 'recording';
            instrument.setAttribute('data-state', 'recording');
            triggerLabel.textContent = 'Stop Recording';
            statusText.textContent = 'LIVE MICROPHONE · CAPTURING';
            privacyMsg.textContent = 'Recording locally in this browser — nothing is uploaded.';
            simBtn.querySelector('span').textContent = 'Run Visual Simulation';

            startTimer();
            if (!APP_STATE.reducedMotion && analyser) {
              animateLiveMic();
            }
          } catch (err) {
            activateVisualFallback('Microphone permission was declined or unavailable — switched to honest visual-only simulation mode.');
          }
        });

        // Visual Simulation Button
        simBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          if (mode === 'simulated') {
            stopVisualFallback();
          } else {
            activateVisualFallback('Visual-only simulation active — deterministic waveform study (no microphone audio captured).');
          }
        });

        // Save recorded clip to Chapter 05 Memory Library for this session
        saveBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          if (!recordedBlobUrl) return;
          const newId = `mem-session-${Date.now()}`;
          const now = new Date();
          const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString([], { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' });
          const newMemory = {
            id: newId,
            title: `Voice Note (${timeStr})`,
            category: 'voice',
            tagLabel: 'Voice / Session Clip',
            duration: lastDurationFormatted,
            timestamp: `TODAY, ${timeStr.toUpperCase()}`,
            note: 'Captured locally in your browser during this session. Playable via the recorder above.',
            wavePrimary: 'M0,32 Q25,5 50,32 T100,32 T150,32 T200,32 T250,32 T300,32 T350,32 T400,32 T450,32 T500,32 T560,32',
            waveSub: 'M0,32 Q25,55 50,32 T100,32 T150,32 T200,32 T250,32 T300,32 T350,32 T400,32 T450,32 T500,32 T560,32',
            miniBars: [15, 21, 12, 19, 22, 10, 17, 14]
          };

          APP_STATE.memories.unshift(newMemory);
          APP_STATE.activeFilter = 'voice';
          APP_STATE.selectedMemoryId = newId;
          if (typeof APP_STATE.renderMemoryLibrary === 'function') {
            APP_STATE.renderMemoryLibrary();
          }

          saveBtn.textContent = '✓ Saved to Voice Archive Below';
          saveBtn.disabled = true;
        });

        // Delete recording & release Blob URL
        deleteBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          stopActiveStreams();
          if (recordedBlobUrl) {
            URL.revokeObjectURL(recordedBlobUrl);
            recordedBlobUrl = null;
          }
          audioPlayer.removeAttribute('src');
          audioPlayer.load();
          playbackTray.classList.remove('is-visible');
          timerEl.textContent = '00:00.0';
          statusText.textContent = 'READY · LOCAL SESSION';
          privacyMsg.textContent = 'Recording deleted and local memory released.';
          resetBars();
        });

        window.addEventListener('pagehide', stopActiveStreams);
      }

      /* ======================================================================
         7. initPinnedMemoryJourney()
         ====================================================================== */
      function initPinnedMemoryJourney() {
        const stepButtons = document.querySelectorAll('.journey-step-btn');
        const panels = document.querySelectorAll('.journey-visual-panel');
        const orbitNodes = document.querySelectorAll('.orbit-node');
        const progressLine = document.getElementById('journey-progress-line');

        let currentStage = 0;

        const setStageUI = (index, rawProgress) => {
          if (index !== currentStage) {
            currentStage = index;
            stepButtons.forEach((btn, i) => {
              const active = i === index;
              btn.classList.toggle('is-active', active);
              btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(active));
            });

            panels.forEach((panel, i) => {
              panel.classList.toggle('is-active', i === index);
            });

            orbitNodes.forEach((node, i) => {
              if (i <= index) {
                node.setAttribute('fill', '#E9715E');
                node.setAttribute('r', i === index ? '7.5' : '6');
              } else {
                node.setAttribute('fill', '#2D1518');
                node.setAttribute('r', '6');
              }
            });
          }

          if (progressLine && typeof rawProgress === 'number') {
            const totalLen = 252;
            const offset = totalLen * (1 - Math.max(0, Math.min(1, rawProgress)));
            progressLine.style.strokeDashoffset = String(offset);
          }
        };

        // Clicking rail steps scrolls to the exact stage or switches directly
        stepButtons.forEach((btn) => {
          btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const stepIndex = parseInt(btn.getAttribute('data-journey-step') || '0', 10);
            const st = APP_STATE.journeyScrollTrigger;

            if (st && window.innerWidth >= 768 && !APP_STATE.reducedMotion) {
              const targetProgress = stepIndex === 0 ? 0.12 : stepIndex === 1 ? 0.48 : 0.84;
              const targetScroll = st.start + (st.end - st.start) * targetProgress;
              window.scrollTo({
                top: targetScroll,
                behavior: 'smooth'
              });
            } else {
              setStageUI(stepIndex, stepIndex / 2);
            }
          });
        });

        if (!APP_STATE.hasGSAP || APP_STATE.reducedMotion) return;

        const gsap = window.gsap;
        const mm = gsap.matchMedia();

        mm.add('(min-width: 768px)', () => {
          const st = window.ScrollTrigger.create({
            trigger: '#journey-pin-wrap',
            pin: true,
            start: 'top top',
            end: '+=320%',
            scrub: 0.4,
            onUpdate: (self) => {
              const p = self.progress;
              // Partitioned with generous dwell holds:
              // 0.00 - 0.32: Stage 01 CAPTURE
              // 0.32 - 0.66: Stage 02 ORGANIZE
              // 0.66 - 1.00: Stage 03 REVISIT (held clearly through 1.00)
              const stageIdx = p < 0.32 ? 0 : p < 0.66 ? 1 : 2;
              setStageUI(stageIdx, p);
            }
          });

          APP_STATE.journeyScrollTrigger = st;

          return () => {
            st.kill();
            APP_STATE.journeyScrollTrigger = null;
          };
        });
      }

      /* ======================================================================
         8. initMemoryLibrary()
         ====================================================================== */
      function initMemoryLibrary() {
        const filterBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-tab-btn');
        const pillIndicator = document.getElementById('filter-pill-indicator');
        const listContainer = document.getElementById('memory-list');
        const emptyState = document.getElementById('memory-empty-state');
        const readingPane = document.getElementById('memory-reading-pane');
        const paneCat = document.getElementById('reading-pane-category');
        const paneTitle = document.getElementById('reading-pane-title');
        const paneMeta = document.getElementById('reading-pane-meta');
        const paneNote = document.getElementById('reading-pane-note');
        const wavePrimary = document.getElementById('reading-pane-wave-path');
        const waveSub = document.getElementById('reading-pane-wave-sub');

        const updateFilterIndicator = () => {
          const activeBtn = document.querySelector(`.filter-tab-btn[data-filter="${APP_STATE.activeFilter}"]`);
          if (!activeBtn || !pillIndicator) return;
          pillIndicator.style.width = `${activeBtn.offsetWidth}px`;
          pillIndicator.style.transform = `translateX(${activeBtn.offsetLeft - 5}px)`;
        };

        const updateReadingPane = (mem) => {
          if (!mem) return;
          if (!APP_STATE.reducedMotion && readingPane) {
            readingPane.style.opacity = '0.45';
            setTimeout(() => { readingPane.style.opacity = '1'; }, 160);
          }
          paneCat.textContent = mem.tagLabel.toUpperCase();
          paneTitle.textContent = mem.title;
          paneMeta.textContent = `${mem.duration} · ${mem.timestamp}`;
          paneNote.textContent = mem.note;
          if (wavePrimary) wavePrimary.setAttribute('d', mem.wavePrimary);
          if (waveSub) waveSub.setAttribute('d', mem.waveSub);
        };

        const renderList = () => {
          filterBtns.forEach((btn) => {
            const isSelected = btn.getAttribute('data-filter') === APP_STATE.activeFilter;
            btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(isSelected));
          });
          updateFilterIndicator();

          const filtered = APP_STATE.memories.filter((m) =>
            APP_STATE.activeFilter === 'all' ? true : m.category === APP_STATE.activeFilter
          );

          listContainer.innerHTML = '';

          if (filtered.length === 0) {
            emptyState.classList.add('is-visible');
            return;
          }

          emptyState.classList.remove('is-visible');

          if (!filtered.some(m => m.id === APP_STATE.selectedMemoryId)) {
            APP_STATE.selectedMemoryId = filtered[0].id;
          }

          filtered.forEach((mem, idx) => {
            const btn = document.createElement('button');
            btn.type = 'button';
            const isSelected = mem.id === APP_STATE.selectedMemoryId;
            btn.className = `memory-row-btn${isSelected ? ' is-selected' : ''}`;
            btn.setAttribute('role', 'option');
            btn.setAttribute('aria-selected', String(isSelected));

            const barsSvg = mem.miniBars
              .map((h, i) => `<rect x="${i * 8 + 2}" y="${11 - h / 2}" width="3.5" height="${h}" rx="1.5" fill="#DB705D"/>`)
              .join('');

            btn.innerHTML = `
              <span class="memory-row-index">0${idx + 1}</span>
              <span class="memory-row-title">${mem.title}</span>
              <span class="memory-row-tag">${mem.tagLabel}</span>
              <svg class="memory-row-miniwave" viewBox="0 0 68 22" aria-hidden="true">${barsSvg}</svg>
            `;

            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
              APP_STATE.selectedMemoryId = mem.id;
              renderList();
            });

            listContainer.appendChild(btn);
          });

          const activeMem = filtered.find(m => m.id === APP_STATE.selectedMemoryId) || filtered[0];
          updateReadingPane(activeMem);
        };

        filterBtns.forEach((btn) => {
          btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            APP_STATE.activeFilter = btn.getAttribute('data-filter') || 'all';
            renderList();
          });
        });

        const seedVoiceBtn = document.getElementById('seed-voice-sample-btn');
        if (seedVoiceBtn) {
          seedVoiceBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const sampleId = 'mem-voice-sample';
            if (!APP_STATE.memories.some(m => m.id === sampleId)) {
              APP_STATE.memories.unshift({
                id: sampleId,
                title: 'Midnight walk reflection',
                category: 'voice',
                tagLabel: 'Voice / Quiet Note',
                duration: '00:46',
                timestamp: 'NOV 04, 11:12 PM',
                note: 'A quiet spoken reminder recorded walking home after the rain stopped — footsteps and low voice memo.',
                wavePrimary: 'M0,32 Q22,6 44,32 T88,32 T132,32 T176,32 T220,32 T264,32 T308,32 T352,32 T396,32 T440,32 T484,32 T528,32 T560,32',
                waveSub: 'M0,32 Q22,56 44,32 T88,32 T132,32 T176,32 T220,32 T264,32 T308,32 T352,32 T396,32 T440,32 T484,32 T528,32 T560,32',
                miniBars: [12, 20, 14, 22, 9, 18, 15, 11]
              });
            }
            APP_STATE.selectedMemoryId = sampleId;
            renderList();
          });
        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', updateFilterIndicator);
        APP_STATE.renderMemoryLibrary = renderList;
        renderList();
      }

      /* ======================================================================
         9. initSoundscapeStudy()
         ====================================================================== */
      function initSoundscapeStudy() {
        const section = document.getElementById('soundscape');
        const glow = document.getElementById('soundscape-cursor-glow');
        const modeBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.soundscape-mode-btn');
        const caption = document.getElementById('soundscape-study-caption');
        const tech = document.getElementById('soundscape-study-tech');
        const wavePrimary = document.getElementById('soundscape-wave-primary');
        const waveSecondary = document.getElementById('soundscape-wave-secondary');

        const MODES = {
          rain: {
            caption: 'Steady nocturnal rainfall against glass — high-density micro-transients with warm low-mid resonance.',
            tech: 'PATTERN: STOCHASTIC DROPLET ENVELOPE · SPECTRAL CENTROID 1.8kHz',
            d1: 'M0,80 C180,20 360,140 540,80 C720,20 900,140 1080,80 C1260,20 1350,110 1440,80',
            d2: 'M0,80 C200,135 380,25 580,80 C780,135 940,25 1140,80 C1300,125 1380,50 1440,80'
          },
          city: {
            caption: 'Distant avenue traffic and midnight metro harmonics — wide stereo horizon with deep sub-bass pulse.',
            tech: 'PATTERN: URBAN HARMONIC SWELL · SPECTRAL CENTROID 640Hz',
            d1: 'M0,80 C120,5 240,155 360,80 C480,5 600,155 720,80 C840,5 960,155 1080,80 C1200,5 1320,155 1440,80',
            d2: 'M0,80 C150,150 300,10 450,80 C600,150 750,10 900,80 C1050,150 1200,10 1440,80'
          },
          morning: {
            caption: 'Early dawn stillness and birdsong over cedar trees — delicate upper-harmonic shimmer and long decay.',
            tech: 'PATTERN: HARMONIC DAWN CHORUS · SPECTRAL CENTROID 3.4kHz',
            d1: 'M0,80 C260,48 480,112 720,80 C960,48 1180,112 1440,80',
            d2: 'M0,80 C240,108 480,52 720,80 C960,108 1200,52 1440,80'
          }
        };

        modeBtns.forEach((btn) => {
          btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const key = btn.getAttribute('data-soundscape-mode') || 'rain';
            const data = MODES[key];
            if (!data) return;

            modeBtns.forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(b === btn)));
            caption.textContent = data.caption;
            tech.textContent = data.tech;
            if (wavePrimary) wavePrimary.setAttribute('d', data.d1);
            if (waveSecondary) waveSecondary.setAttribute('d', data.d2);
          });
        });

        if (section && glow && APP_STATE.finePointer && !APP_STATE.reducedMotion) {
          section.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
            const rect = section.getBoundingClientRect();
            const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
            const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
            glow.style.transform = `translate3d(${x - 210}px, ${y - 210}px, 0)`;
          });
        }
      }

      /* ======================================================================
         10. initFinalCTA()
         ====================================================================== */
      function initFinalCTA() {
        if (!APP_STATE.hasGSAP || APP_STATE.reducedMotion) return;
        const gsap = window.gsap;

        gsap.fromTo(
          '#final-phone-card',
          { x: -30, y: 28, scale: 0.97, opacity: 0.68 },
          {
            x: 0,
            y: 0,
            scale: 1,
            opacity: 1,
            ease: 'power2.out',
            scrollTrigger: {
              trigger: '#download',
              start: 'top 80%',
              end: 'center 55%',
              scrub: 0.5
            }
          }
        );

        const footerSignal = document.getElementById('footer-signal-path');
        if (footerSignal && footerSignal.getTotalLength) {
          const len = footerSignal.getTotalLength();
          gsap.set(footerSignal, { strokeDasharray: len, strokeDashoffset: len });
          gsap.to(footerSignal, {
            strokeDashoffset: 0,
            duration: 1.4,
            ease: 'power2.out',
            scrollTrigger: {
              trigger: '.site-footer',
              start: 'top 92%',
              toggleActions: 'play none none none'
            }
          });
        }
      }

      // Run all initializers in sequence
      initReducedMotion();
      initSmoothScroll();
      initNavigation();
      initHeroMotion();
      initManifestoWave();
      initRecorderDemo();
      initPinnedMemoryJourney();
      initMemoryLibrary();
      initSoundscapeStudy();
      initFinalCTA();

      // Refresh ScrollTrigger after lazy/hero images finish layout
      window.addEventListener('load', () => {
        if (APP_STATE.hasGSAP) {
          window.ScrollTrigger.refresh();
        }
      });
    });
  </script>
<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    const form = document.getElementById('footer-concept-form');
    const feedback = document.getElementById('footer-form-feedback');
    if (!form || !feedback) return;
    form.addEventListener('submit', function(event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      feedback.textContent = 'This is a concept demo — nothing was subscribed, saved, or sent.';
      form.reset();
    });
  });
</script>
